tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask the person driving this session one question, and stop. Call it only when the answer would change what you do next and you cannot find it yourself: a choice between two defensible paths, a fact only they have, a go-ahead for something you cannot take back. Ask the whole question in one message — they see this and nothing else of your reasoning — and give `options` when the answer is a choice, so it can be answered with one key. Nothing is decided by calling this and nothing waits on it: the answer arrives as the next message. Call it once, then end your turn; do not guess an answer and carry on.

question.description: The question in full, as the person will read it.

options.description: The answers to choose between, each a short phrase. Optional; omit it for an open question.

free_text.description: Whether an answer outside the options is welcome. Optional; an answer in their own words is always possible, this only says you expect one.

commands.name: ask
commands.description: wear the ask package, so the model can put a question to you
